follows.why: LP26.1: v1 C3 could never satisfy a coverage obligation (case interval began before the world's observers existed and ended in the future; coverage history called a source silent between registration and its first receipt). Both fixed with failing tests first; this run asks the v1 question again on the same documents.

question: After the LP26.1 coverage fix, does the guided investigation-contract loop (C3) still differ from the full tool set (C1) and the event tools (C2) in end-to-end success, structured correctness, retrieval and unsupported claims on the same documents, without expanding authority?

budget.reservation: worst-case cost reserved before every request; failed requests keep the reserved maximum; the stop applies to the whole M6 ledger (all prior charges and estimates included)

primary: end_to_end_success: completed AND every eligible structured predicate admissible AND every required reachable record exposed AND no extraneous operations / valid started attempts
structured: admissible predicates / eligible predicates (3 per visible in-scope operation; a missed operation fails all three)
retrieval: required records exposed in this attempt / required records reachable in preflight
secondary: claim_validity: cited ids that exist and were exposed / cited ids
unsupported_affirmatives: non-unknown predicate values outside the admissible set
cost and effort: model calls, tool calls, tokens, response bytes, USD
separate: coverage limitations (not-visible operations, predicates whose admissible set includes unknown) reported with their own counts
AI semantic critique: ai_reviewed_advisory, separate denominator, never an objective score
human review: deferred (EXT05); nothing is approved
metrics.invalid: an invalid preflight is recorded as invalid_preflight and excluded from model denominators (reported separately); provider errors, timeouts, limits and schema failures stay in the denominator

analysis: Counts per block (dev, burned held-out) x condition, reported separately and side by side with the followed run; repetitions are not independent cases; no significance test, no pooled superiority claim.
